description:
Create an expense in FreeAgent — for purchases on a personal card or cash that need claiming back. Provide vendor, date, amount, description and category. If categoryUrl is omitted, auto-selects from vendor mapping. Optionally pass bankAccountId to auto-match and explain a corresponding bank transaction (e.g. if the same purchase also appears on a company card).

RECEIPTS: PREFER filePath (a local file — screenshot, PDF, whatever) or fileUrl (a download link); the server reads and encodes it. Avoid fileBase64 for anything but tiny files — large inline base64 is unreliable and the expense lands receiptless. Before asking the user for a file, search connected email tools (Gmail, Outlook/M365) for a matching invoice using vendor name, amount and date, and check local sources (Downloads folder, etc.) if the user has mentioned them.

bankAccountId.description: If supplied, search this bank account for a matching unexplained transaction (same amount, date ±4 days) and link the expense to it.

categoryUrl.description: FreeAgent category URL (e.g. '/v2/categories/285'). Auto-selected from vendor if omitted.

contentType.description: MIME type (e.g. 'application/pdf'). Inferred from fileName if omitted.

description.description: Expense description (e.g. 'Monthly cloud hosting'). Sent as "vendor — description", which must be 255 characters or fewer in total.

ecStatus.description: VAT treatment for the purchase. Defaults to 'UK/Non-EC' — set it for an overseas supplier or a reverse-charge purchase, or the VAT return reports it in the wrong box.

fileBase64.description: Base64-encoded receipt. LAST RESORT — unreliable above a few hundred KB; prefer filePath or fileUrl.

filePath.description: Absolute path to a local receipt file (e.g. '/Users/you/Desktop/screenshot.png'). The SERVER reads and base64-encodes it — PREFER THIS over fileBase64. fileName defaults to the file's name.

fileUrl.description: URL of a receipt to download and attach (e.g. a Stripe 'Download invoice' link). The server fetches and encodes it — no need to handle bytes.

project.description: FreeAgent project URL (e.g. '/v2/projects/123') to tag the expense against, so it can be rebilled or reported per client. Use freeagent_list_projects to find it.

rebillFactor.description: Markup percentage or fixed price — required for markup/price

rebillType.description: How to rebill this to the client — 'cost' bills it on at cost, 'markup' adds a percentage, 'price' charges a fixed price. Requires project. Without it the expense is attributed to the project but never queued to bill on.

receiptReference.description: Supplier's own receipt or invoice number, for matching against a paper trail

vatAmount.description: VAT amount as string (e.g. '3.80'). Use vatRate instead to let FreeAgent work it out.

vatRate.description: VAT rate as a percentage (e.g. '20.0') — FreeAgent calculates the amount

name: freeagent_create_expense
